expected_current_version_id.description: Required optimistic-concurrency guard: the current_version_id the edits are based on (null when the canvas has never been published). Diff edits against a moved head are rejected with 409 version_conflict — they cannot be published unguarded.

id.description: ID of the canvas whose source to edit.

name.description: Optional new display name for the canvas.

operations.description: Edits applied in order to the canvas's current source project.

items.description: One per-path edit: set a file's content, set a stored-asset reference, or delete.

asset.description: Set this path to an image asset uploaded to the canvas's asset store, so tags and imports can reference it. Mutually exclusive with content.

contentType.description:
MIME type of the uploaded asset, from the upload or attach response.

* `image/png` - image/png
* `image/jpeg` - image/jpeg
* `image/gif` - image/gif
* `image/webp` - image/webp
* `image/avif` - image/avif
* `image/svg+xml` - image/svg+xml

sha256.description: Hex sha256 identifying the uploaded asset, from the upload or attach response.

sizeBytes.description: Byte size of the uploaded asset, from the upload or attach response.

content.description: The file's complete new content. With no content and no asset, the path is deleted.

path.description: Project-relative path of the file or asset to write or delete (e.g. "src/canvas.tsx").

prompt.description: Short description of the change, stored on the appended version history entry.
